caseName: Huller v. New Mexico ex rel. Northwestern Colonization & Improvement Co.
caseNameFull: Luis Huller, in Error v. State of New Mexico on the Relation of Northwestern Colonization & Improvement Company of Chihuahua
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of New Mexico.
attorneys: Mr. Walter D. Hawk, Mr. Samuel S. Holmes, Mr. A. B. Renehan, Mr. Charles A. Douglas and Mr. Jo V. Morgan for plaintiffs in error. Mr. James R. Garfield, Mr. D. J. Cable, Mr. Harry L. Patton and Mr. Francis C. Wilson for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of (1) Equitable Assurance Society v. Brown, 187 U. S. 308, 311, 314; Delmar Jockey Club v. Missouri, 210 U. S. 324; Consolidated Turnpike Co. v. Norfolk, etc., Ry. Co., 228 U. S. 596, 599-600. (2) § 237, Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726; Philadelphia & Reading Coal & Iron Co. v. Gilbert, 245 U. S. 162.
